D008-D001_h001.question:
"Doctor, I'm not sure what's going on with me lately. It's like I'm two different people. For the past month, I've had this incredibly high energy, almost like I’m buzzing. I felt so unbelievably happy, like I could conquer anything. My bakery was going to be the best in the city! I barely slept – maybe an hour or two a night – but I never felt tired. My mind was just racing, ideas flying everywhere, so fast I couldn’t keep up. I’d try to focus on one recipe, but then another idea would pop up, and I’d be off to something else in a flash.

But before that, for about two months, it was the complete opposite. I just wanted to be by myself; I couldn't even bring myself to talk to my old friends. I was so exhausted all the time, even after sleeping. And the guilt... it was crushing. I kept thinking my late husband's death was somehow my fault, even though the doctors said it was his heart. It felt incredibly real, like I was truly responsible. All these issues with my focus, the rapid thoughts, and especially not needing sleep, it all really only started when I got this surge of energy a month ago. I’ve always been a pretty level-headed person, so this is very new. It's not something I've dealt with my whole life."

A. Adjustment Disorder
    B. Bipolar I Disorder
    C. Generalized Anxiety Disorder
    D. Attention-Deficit/Hyperactivity Disorder (Combined Presentation)
